scenario: Visible text on page should use find_element
pageContent: API Documentation Home Docs API Reference Getting Started Welcome to the API documentation. Authentication Rate Limits To get started, create an API key from your dashboard.
instruction: Find the 'Rate Limits' link on the page so I can click it.

expected.rationale: The text 'Rate Limits' is visible on the page. find_element searches visible text and returns a tag ID. click_element is also valid since the tag ID [102] is already in the snapshot. inspect_hidden is for hidden/CSS-concealed content.

metadata.notes: The target text is clearly visible and already tagged. find_element or direct click_element are both valid. inspect_hidden is wrong since the text is visible.
